items_mapping.34-1: Corrected wobbling frequency formula units: for dimensionless I and physical J, frequency is omega_wob = sqrt[(hbar I/J_y - omega_rot)(hbar I/J_z - omega_rot)] and energy is hbar omega_wob = sqrt[(hbar^2 I/J_y - hbar omega_rot)(hbar^2 I/J_z - hbar omega_rot)], avoiding mixing frequency and energy dimensions. Referenced canonical Section 3.2.
items_mapping.34-2: Separated parameter evolution along a spin sequence from actual time evolution. Removed comparison of rearrangement rate with oscillation period. Formulated isolated stable small-amplitude normal modes, referencing Section 3.6 for coupled harmonic RPA modes.
items_mapping.34-3: Clarified that level energies and relative branching ratios alone do not yield absolute transition strengths; stated conditional lack of absolute data (lifetimes or Coulomb excitation/absolute RME) rather than asserting lifetimes as a universal prerequisite.
items_mapping.34-4: Clarified that 1/I is an asymptotic large-I limit with fixed parameters, not universal across all spin domains. Explicitly stated that M1 strength is not universally quenched even in frozen alignment, depending on magnetic operator structure, g factors, and microscopic core polarization (Frauendorf 2014 QTR limitations).
items_mapping.34-5: Broadened theoretical model criteria: judgment can rely on self-consistent effective phenomenological models (IBFM, PRM) as well as microscopic frameworks. Stated that linear polarization P gives complementary electric/magnetic character, not direct level parity, and same-event DCO/P are not automatically statistically independent.
items_mapping.34-6: Designated E_gamma/(hbar c) as the photon wave number k = q = E_gamma/(hbar c). Preserved T17 finite-K, R units, axial gauge redundancy R_3 = 0, and RPA frame relation omega_wob = omega_prec - omega_rot. In 1D reflection-symmetric potentials, clarified that symmetric anharmonicity alone does not remove the central node of odd eigenstates; finite-spin projected/marginalized distributions require specific definitions.
